description: Search the full GW1 skill database by profession, attribute, campaign, elite flag or name fragment (valid values are documented per parameter). Returns compact records, at most `limit` of them alongside a `total` count of every match — a full page is not the whole result, page with offset. Use get_skill for full details.

attributeName.description: Filter by attribute line, exact English name, e.g. "Blood Magic", "Swordsmanship", "Divine Favor".

campaignName.description: Filter by the campaign a skill was INTRODUCED in: Core, Prophecies, Factions, Nightfall, or Eye of the North. Not a filter on availability — every attribute line spans several campaigns, so combining this with attributeName hides most of the line. Omit it when exploring an attribute.

elite.description: If true, return only elite skills; if false, only non-elite; omit for both.

includePvpVersions.description: Include separate '(PvP)' skill versions. Default false — most builds want the PvE version only.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–200, default 50). Narrow filters if you hit it.

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the ENGLISH skill name, e.g. "heal" matches every skill with 'heal' in its name. A French substring matches nothing — use get_skill for a French name.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging through results beyond the limit.

professionName.description: Filter by profession: Warrior, Ranger, Monk, Necromancer, Mesmer, Elementalist, Assassin, Ritualist, Paragon, Dervish, or None (common / PvE-only skills that belong to no profession).

name: search_skills

skills.description: Compact records; use get_skill for full details

total.description: Total matches before limit/offset are applied

title: Search Guild Wars 1 skills
